The '''Gathering Circle''' was the sector on [[Kegan/Legends|Kegan]] where meetings were held. It was located in the center of Kegan's [[City/Legends|city]], with all the other circles of the city forming a ring around it. The [[Central Dwelling]] was located within the Gathering Circle, next to an open-air coliseum where the people of Kegan met to discuss problems.
